reviews.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Review - An Assembly Of Champions
evidence: As an avid fighting game player and fan of Marvel Comics, I've been looking forward to Arc System Works' Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls. Gameplay betas and showcases have shown this title evolving, shaped by player feedback over time. Featuring 4v4 team battles in a classic format, the final product is an impressive addition to a storied genre.
